verdict.summary: The server now forwards sparq-engine's opt-in dp-planner feature and includes it in the binary crate's default feature set, while preserving the documented no-default-features opt-out and leaving the engine library default unchanged. The new integration tests are non-vacuous for answer equivalence and scoped-state restoration, and the compile-time reference to without_dp_planner verifies that the forwarding reaches the engine feature. Existing engine implementation confirms that the compiled feature starts in Install::Default with the bounded DP configuration, while the existing differential test compares DP and greedy bags against an independent nested-loop reference. Documentation and the HTTP-server skill are updated consistently. No hostile instructions were found in the diff.
